description_en: Creates a routing rule for a VPC firewall for a transit router. [Prerequisites] Activate Cloud Firewall → Create a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance → Create an Enterprise Edition transit router → Add VPCs to the transit router route table → Call CreateTrFirewallV2 to create a VPC firewall for the transit router
